cohort: The study included 1190 pregnancies of women living with HIV (WLWH) who initiated antenatal care at or before 14 weeks of gestation at the Coptic Hope Center in Nairobi and Maseno, Kenya between 2008 and 2017.
finding: Maternal obesity among WLWH in Kenya increased from 2008-2017, GWG rates remained suboptimal, and a one-unit increase in GWG z-score was associated with higher birthweight and increased risk of emergency c-section.
mod_finding: A one-unit increase in GWG z-score was associated with an increased risk of emergency c-section (aRR=1.35, 95 % CI: 1.03-1.82).
